## Which is it

- [ ] A claim was reported supported on evidence that does not support it
- [ ] A claim was reported missing when the evidence exists somewhere else
- [ ] The wording of the claim promises more than the collector checks
- [ ] The rationale does not survive contact with a real reviewer
- [ ] A report was not reproducible — two runs, two digests
